action: “Every shell on this screen is trying to predict something. The grant, the playlists, the permits. Somebody's got a model of this block, and I think they've been checking it since you were six. Nineteen years.” She half-closes the laptop (which, from Sofía, is a gesture of love on the order of a kidney). “We need to find out what they did with the children who kept reacting. Don't answer the email. Don't delete it. And don't walk home past the bodega.” “Why?” “Because I just spent an hour telling you I don't believe in your loop, and I'd like to still be wrong tomorrow. Also eat a vegetable. Platanitos don't count.”
